More recently, the Open Catalyst 2022 (OC22) framework has provided a large dataset of density functional theory (DFT) calculations for OER intermediates on the surfaces of oxides.

More recently, the Open Catalyst 2022 (OC22) framework has expanded upon this dataset by incorporating random combinations of 4732 oxide materials, Miller indices up to 3, and surface intermediates involved in OER.

evidence.text: In this work, we interpolated a database of the total energy predictions for all slabs and OER surface intermediates for 4119 oxide materials in the original OC22 dataset using pre-trained models from the OC22 framework.
Using the previously developed ML models, we systematically extrapolated the total DFT energy of all terminations for all facets up to a MMI = 1 for all 4119 materials considered in this study.

dataset_uses.purpose: Screen candidates using progressive criteria including Pourbaix stability, Wulff shape analysis, overpotential assessment, energy above hull, and material cost.

evidence.text: Fig. 5 summarizes the selection criteria that we employed to screen for candidate electrocatalysts for OER. The first criteria in our high-throughput screening framework was to determine if a material exists in the original training dataset of OC22. ... The second criterion describes the Pourbaix stability, i.e., the electrochemical stability of a material in aqueous environment. ... The third selection criterion ... assesses the surface energy ... to construct the Wulff shape ... The fourth criterion assesses the overpotential ... The fifth criterion assesses the thermodynamic stability ... The final criterion assesses the material cost ...
In total we have identified 190 candidates (122 bulk – and 68 nanostable) with 145 distinct chemical systems when considering all the different screening frameworks listed in Table 2.
